flags: minor: matrices given in words only; a displayed matrix would be more ACT-like
B042-01.notes: Sum entries of A = 6, so 2A sums to 12; B sums to 6; total 18. Distractor A (12) = sum of 2A only.

B042-02.notes: Reference angle 30 deg in QII, sine positive: 1/2.

B042-03.notes: x^2/9 + y^2/4 = 1, unequal positive coefficients: ellipse.

B042-04.notes: (1,3): 3>1 and 4<5. (1,0) fails first; (3,4) fails first (4>5 false); (2,4) fails second (6<5 false). Unique.

B042-06.notes: Common denominator x(x+1): (x+1+x)/(x(x+1)) = (2x+1)/(x(x+1)). Checked at x=2: C=5/6, A=2/5, B=1/3, D=2/3; no distractor equivalent.

B042-07.notes: Triangle with vertices (0,0), (-4,4), (4,4): base 8, height 4, area 16. Distractor A = half-base error, C = forgot 1/2.

B042-08.notes: Side = sqrt(6^2+8^2)=10; area = 12*16/2 = 96 = side*height so height 9.6, radius = 4.8 (equivalently 6*8/10). Needs insight that inradius = half the distance between opposite sides; D (9.6) is the trap.

B042-10.notes: Rates: walkway L/60, combined L/20, walking = L/20 - L/60 = L/30 -> 30 s. Trap B (40 = 60-20) catches subtractors of times.
